role_strata: randomized treatment group crossed with presence of basal and bolus files; no glucose outcome stratification
role_assignment: stratified 34-patient reserve; four stratified shuffled development folds
reserved_status: Previously included in aggregate source audit. Monolithic source files must be scanned, but reserved rows are filtered before timestamp/value conversion; no reserved feature caches or prediction scores.
availability_interpretation: retrospective engineering assumptions, not verified upload times
target_matching: nearest observed post-randomization reading within +/-30 seconds of issue+horizon; equidistant ties choose earlier; no interpolation; report strict zero-offset support and scores separately
target_availability: matched source timestamp plus five minutes, not nominal target time
boundary_policy: retain source codes and history flags; use 40/400 bounded input proxies; exclude non-exact boundary-coded targets from point-error scoring and report their counts separately; no event-label claim
duplicate_policy: identical CGM timestamp values reconcile; conflicting values withhold at that timestamp; basal conflicting rates become unknown; bolus remove only identical complete source records, never RecID alone
clinical_availability: screening visit date plus one day; screening local HbA1c later of test/visit date plus one day; mask each field until available; no central/follow-up labs
clinical_missingness: unknown flags and missing units remain missing; no patient exclusion for missing clinical fields; imputation/scaling fitted on each training fold only
pump_timestamps: use adjusted event timestamp when populated, otherwise original; preserve adjustment counts
pump_row_admission: CGM history and measured target only; missing/stale pump data never remove comparator rows
basal_features: known-rate integrals over 30/60/120 minutes with known-duration fractions; commanded units/hour, not verified delivered totals; expired state unknown, not zero
bolus_features: observed standard/extended amounts and counts in 30/60/120/240/360-minute past windows; bounded recency with missing/stale flags; absence of an event is not confirmed zero delivery

models.persistence: latest available exact reading or boundary proxy; same scoring rows

fit_weights: equal patient total weight; deterministic within-patient sampling; identical selected rows in each comparison
model_selection: fixed initial configurations; no outer-fold-driven tuning or deployment
issue_schedule: one issue per reconciled native CGM timestamp plus the five-minute assumed availability delay; do not align sensors to wall-clock bins
revision_reason: Before fitting, v1 clock-grid admission retained only about 20% of labels because native sensor minute offsets vary. V2 preserves native timestamp phase with the same target tolerance, history rules and patient roles.
